newsitem.title: USA: Staples /Office Depot merger seen soon - arbs.
newsitem.headline: Staples /Office Depot merger seen soon - arbs.

text.p: The merger of Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc is back on track with their agreement to sell 63 stores to competitor OfficeMax Inc, making completion of the $4 billion deal possible within two weeks, arbitrageurs said.

Consumation of the Staples/Office Depot stock-swap combination, first announced last September, was threatened Monday when the U.S. Federal Trade Commission rejected the merger on the basis that it would mean higher prices for consumers.
"The FTC is going to be jumping for joy with the (proposed) settlement because they did not want to go to court," said an arbitrageur who declined to be named. "It is a big deal done."

A second arb who asked not to be identified said, "The government did not necessarily have a slam-dunk case, and it is going to be very happy that everyone saves face with the agreement" for the expected merged company to sell key stores to rival OfficeMax.
